Hister — your own personal search engine!

Hister indexes the full content of web pages you visit and files you keep, making everything searchable from a web interface, terminal, or even an AI assistant.

Runs locally or on your own server
Firefox & Chrome extensions
No telemetry or mandatory cloud services

Take control of your personal knowledge and search history!
